## Overview

This directory contains Enterprise Standards related to technology selection, platform adoption, vendor management, and technology governance to ensure consistent technology decisions across the enterprise.
page_texts.4:
[standards/technology/README.md#examples-of-technology-standards]

## Examples of Technology Standards

- Technology evaluation and selection criteria for enterprise technology decisions
- Platform standardization requirements for development and deployment
- Vendor assessment and management standards for third-party relationships
- Technology lifecycle management procedures for technology evolution
- Open source adoption and governance standards for community technology
- Cloud platform strategy standards for multi-cloud environments
- Development toolchain standards for consistent development practices
- Technology architecture review standards for design approval processes
- Licensing and compliance standards for software asset management
- Technology risk assessment and mitigation standards

[standards/technology/README.md#domain-specific-standards-summary]

### Domain-Specific Standards Summary

- **Container Orchestration**: Amazon EKS standards for enterprise Kubernetes deployments
- **Diagramming**: draw.io/diagrams.net and Mermaid tool standards for all IT practitioners
- **Frontend Development**: Next.js standards for React-based web applications
- **Backend Development**: Python standards for microservices and API development; Node.js standards for backend microservices and BFF services
- **Data & Caching**: Redis standards for distributed caching and message queuing
- **Identity Management**: PingOne standards for enterprise identity and access management
- **Documentation**: Markdown and MkDocs standards for consistent technical documentation
